purpose: Screen encode-decode reconstruction error as a cheap designability signal against already audited real refold outcomes; do not train a proxy or alter success criteria.
sources: Training-only feedback49941786:16generated and8native backbones. Development conditioned outputs from assays49900262,49903663,49919660,49933169,49938555,49949949:48generated backbones over4reused families. Add4experimental controls once. All76inputs retained; native controls excluded from predictive statistics.
measurement: Canonicalize each complete backbone using its own CA principal frame, encode with frozenProteinAE, per-residue layer normalization, decode with AE3 under2fixed independent noise seeds. Primary score is negative mean proper-rotation CA reconstruction RMSD. Distance RMS is diagnostic only. Input frame uses no desired/native reference. Seed2026100244.
controls: Four fixed longest-per-cohort rigid-pose encoder controls, coordinates and latent errors<=1e-4. At least10of12native/calibration controls must have mean CA reconstruction RMSD<=1A. Save all152reconstructions and independently recompute scores. Finite shape checks; one bounded10minute RTX diagnostic, no new refolds or learned weights.
analysis: Predict valid globally agreeing refold success, separately for generated training and development samples that were already coarse-valid. AUROC with ties, family bootstrap, and equally weighted within-family AUROC across mixed-label families. Strict motif retention remains a separate outcome and is never inferred from this proxy.
followup_gate: Exploratory signal only if both cohorts have pooled AUROC>=.7 and within-family AUROC>=.7 with at least3mixed-label families. Even a pass requires a fresh training-family refold validation before any proxy-based training or selection claim. No score/threshold sweep, no locked tests. A failure closes this proxy recipe.
